summary: App with leaderboard and admin functionality; requested UI tweaks, admin delete fix, admin sign-in logging, and in-app notifications.
known_issues: Admin tab delete buttons do not function for Users and Availabilities.

existing_features.title: Update the UI where Win and Loss labels are currently stacked vertically so they render side-by-side on the same row (horizontal layout) while preserving existing styling as much as possible.

Fix the Admin tab delete buttons so they immediately delete (a) a selected user and (b) a selected user-day availability entry, and then update the Admin UI to reflect the deletion without requiring a manual refresh.
Add an admin-only sign-in time log: record each user’s latest sign-in timestamp and display it in the Admin tab (Admin Panel) as a readable date/time per user.
Add in-app toast notifications (small pop-up toasts) that trigger: (a) when another user sets an availability, and (b) when the current user experiences any positive rank change on the leaderboard.

new_feature_requests.summary: UI: Place Win and Loss labels side-by-side (horizontal) instead of stacked vertically.
Fix: Admin tab delete buttons should remove items immediately for both Users and Availabilities.
Feature: Add user sign-in time log visible only to admins in the Admin tab.
Feature: In-app toast notifications for (a) when another user sets an availability and (b) when a user has any positive rank change on the leaderboard.

projectName: Leaderboard win/loss layout tweak, fix admin deletes, add admin login log, and in-app notifications
